newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - July 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - July 1.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN - West African Economic and Monetary Union UEMOA decision to reduce duties and taxes on industrial products made in the eight nations in the zone took effect today Tuesday; increases reduction on duties on products that qualify from 30 percent to 60 percent. - The Ivorian national association of loans and savings cooperatives ANAC-CI has seen savings rise by 357 percent since the end of 1994 and has a loan recovery rate of over 95 percent, its managing director Pierre Sarlieve tells annual meeting LE JOUR - Lecture halls at Ivory Coast's largest university campus, Cocody in the commercial capital Abidjan, remain empty as students continue to boycott classes in dispute over grants and academic and living conditions - Agro-industrial company Cosmivoire, subsidiary of Ivory Coast's SIFCA conglomerate, opens new palm oil processing plant
